Exercise: Looking At Ceiling

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- spinal_extension_with_hip_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- stretch_quadriceps,_hamstrings,_and_lower_back

Contraindications:

- lower back pain

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Kneel on the floor, holding your heels with both hands.
- Lift your buttocks up and forward while bringing your head back to look up at the ceiling, to give an arch in your back.
